blocks.text: The International Criminal Court (ICC) in The Hague holds the third status conference on the crimes against humanity case of former Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte. The ICC chamber is set to tackle a several topics, which include the prosecution’s case against Duterte, particularly their list of witnesses, list of evidence, their disclosure to the defense, other possible incidents, as well as the amount of time to be allotted to the prosecution to present its case. Watch it live here. Rodrigo Duterte finally appears in person before ICC MANILA, Philippines — Former President Rodrigo Duterte on Wednesday finally appeared before the International […]...
